def test_the_result_is_jpeg_under_the_old_name(self):
        shaped = to_shape(upload_of(500, 500, name="vesna.png"), PORTRAIT)
        assert shaped.name == "vesna.jpg"
        with Image.open(shaped) as image:
            assert image.format == "JPEG"
